scripts.title: 0 Gravity Gay Script OPEN SOURCE
scripts.script:
-- 0 Gravity Script
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local gravityEnabled = false
local guiExists = false

local function createGravityToggleButton()
    if guiExists then return end
    guiExists = true

    local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    screenGui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

    local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
    button.Size = UDim2.new(0, 120, 0, 50)
    button.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -60, 0.05, 0)
    button.Text = "0 Gravity: Off"
    button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(128, 0, 128)
    button.BackgroundTransparency = 0.6
    button.Parent = screenGui
    button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)

    local closeButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
    closeButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 15)
    closeButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 70, 0.05, 0)
    closeButton.Text = "X"
    closeButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
    closeButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    closeButton.Parent = screenGui

    closeButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        screenGui:Destroy()
        game.Workspace.Gravity = 196.2
        gravityEnabled = false
        guiExists = false
    end)

    button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        if gravityEnabled then
            game.Workspace.Gravity = 196.2
            button.Text = "0 Gravity: Off"
            button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
        else
            game.Workspace.Gravity = 0
            button.Text = "0 Gravity: On"
            button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
        end
        gravityEnabled = not gravityEnabled
    end)
end

createGravityToggleButton()

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(newCharacter)
    character = newCharacter
    humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

    wait(00.3)
    createGravityToggleButton()

    if gravityEnabled then
        game.Workspace.Gravity = 0
    end
end)
